name: The Hidden Cavern
note: Suleiman's Hidden Cavern combat arena (roadmap Phase 11, his THE CAVE sheet), widened to 11 by 11 for 4 against 4 (roadmap 14.2, 15 Nov): a sealed sandstone cavern lit only by fire. The ritual platform with its sigil stands in the middle at mid height, ringed by water; four wooden bridges cross to the walkways. High ledges sit in the corners, and a lookout tower stands on each side wall (level 3), fed by two spring pools: the high ground for archers on the flanks. Lanes three tiles wide run round both sides of the water, so units can go round the platform instead of only over it. You can't climb from the water straight onto the platform (two levels up), so the bridges are the way in.
boardNote: size = columns and rows (the board is square; 9 before roadmap 14.2); tile sizes in the game's pixels. Bigger tiles than the first map give the characters more room (Suleiman 30 Oct).
cameraNote: follow: on a small screen the camera follows the unit whose turn it is, zoomed in; drag to look around, pinch or mouse wheel to see the whole board, or tap the little map top right.
heightsNote: Levels as in his height breakdown: 0 water, 1 low, 2 mid, 3 high. Row 0 is the far side, where the enemies start. The map is a mirror both ways, so both sides have the same ground.
terrainNote: One letter per tile: F stone floor, S sand, R rubble, G the ritual platform's sigil stone, W shallow water (walkable; it leaves you Drenched), B a wooden bridge over the water.
sigilCircleNote: His sigil ring is drawn across the 3 by 3 platform around this tile.
lineUpNote: Phase 10 (20 Nov): the two kings fight here too, Alagara (h5) with the heroes and Gadara (e5) with the enemies; four a side is the most, so in the default team they take the last place (Kofi and the archer sit out; pick them on the character select). M10b (roadmap 18.22, 14 Nov): 4 against 4. Kofi (h4, benched in units.json so the old test map stays 3 v 3) fights here, and the bull is back (he used to sit out). To go back to 3 v 3: alsoFighting ["e1"], sittingOut ["e2"]. Older note: Roadmap 4.3 (Suleiman 29 Oct): Tayo swaps in for the bull, 3 against 3: Rabdul, Tayo and the archer. Units benched in units.json who fight here go in alsoFighting; units who sit this map out go in sittingOut. Four enemies were tried 1 Nov (the bull too): the heroes lost every test battle.
startsNote: Where each unit starts (column, row), by its id in units.json. On the 11 by 11 map (14.2) both sides stand where they stood on the old 9 by 9 map, one tile further in: the walk to the first fight is the same, and the new room is on the flanks and behind.
waterfallsNote: Water pouring off a ledge: [column, row] of the ledge, then [column, row] of the water below. The first eight pour off the platform; the last eight feed the spring pools by the side towers. Only the faces turned towards the camera show.
lampsNote: Ritual lamps (decoration, and the light they give): on the platform's corner tiles, the four high corners and the two side towers, each at the tile's outer corner.
surroundNote: The cavern round the board, as the camera sees it (so it stays behind the board when the camera turns): a ledge one tile deep at ledgeHeight with his props on it, then rock walls wallHeight levels high. at = [view column, view row]; -1 is the ledge. Props: stalagmiteTall, stalagmiteShort, rockPile, pillar, pots, brazier (lit), bones, rockPool.
digsitesNote: Things buried on the board (roadmap 5.3). A unit next to one (or on a dropped satchel) digs it up as its action and gets the item. A pot or bone pile blocks its tile until dug. prop: pots or bones; item: an id from items.json. On the 11 by 11 map they sit in quiet corners off the lanes, so a pot never blocks a route.
